gen.title: Macro scale derivation of Bernoulli equation

steps.label: Begin from conservation of energy
steps.quote: We shall derive Bernoulli’s equation by starting with the conservation of energy equation.

steps.label: Simplify for steady inviscid enthalpy form
steps.quote: Assuming a steady, inviscid flow we have a simplified conservation of energy equation in terms of the enthalpy of the fluid:

steps.label: Remove heat transfer and work
steps.quote: Assuming no heat transfer into the fluid, and no work done by the fluid, we have:

steps.label: Retain pressure work and kinetic terms
Express specific volume as inverse density
Apply incompressible assumption for total pressure
